title: Statements of a three-line shape
statement: Let $p$ be a three-line circuit shape on $n$ inputs. Its statement list has three entries: the first two apply their specified operations to their respective pairs of signed input literals, and the third applies its specified operation to the values of lines $0$ and $1$.
